mechanism_narrative: The current federal funds rate of 0.09% is historically low, and historical data shows that when the federal funds rate is below 0.5%, the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day forward returns in over 70% of cases.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 30% of cases when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: When the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 240, it signals persistent inflation, leading to monetary policy tightening and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 30% of cases when CPIAUCSL > 240.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeds 5.5% and industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 100, it signals a deteriorating economic cycle, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 30% of cases when UNRATE > 5.5 AND INDPRO < 100.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle defined by a 3-month rise in FEDFUNDS above 0.5% and a 3-month rise in CPIAUCSL above 0.5%, the S&P 500 produces negative 20-day forward returns due to reduced liquidity and growth concerns.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rises > 0.5% in 3 months AND CPIAUCSL rises > 0.5% in 3 months
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 30% of cases when FEDFUNDS rises > 0.5% in 3 months AND CPIAUCSL rises > 0.5% in 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 900, it signals a weakening housing market and broader economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 30% of cases when HOUST < 900.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 100, it signals a contraction in the manufacturing sector, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 30% of cases when INDPRO < 100.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeds 6.0%, it signals a deteriorating labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 30% of cases when UNRATE > 6.0.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 900 and industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 100, it signals a simultaneous contraction in the housing and manufacturing sectors, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 30% of cases when HOUST < 900 AND INDPRO < 100.
